Title: A pool pump uses about as much electricity a year as AC
Description: EIA survey data on what uses the most electricity at home: water heaters, AC, and heat lead, pool pumps and EVs rival them, and dehumidifiers add up. Costs inside.

Title: Where the fridge smell is strongest tells you the source
Description: Fridge still smells after a full clean? Find the source by where it's strongest: drawer channels, drip pan, water filter, or a rodent behind it. Plus a 40°F check.
Keywords: food storage and leftovers, appliance efficiency, odors and moisture

Title: Water still there after 24 hours? Your soil isn't draining
Description: A spot that puddles every rain is low, compacted, or fed by runoff. Use the 6-hour hole test, a pen test, and thin topdressing to find and fix which it is.
Keywords: pests and drainage, lawn care, outdoor maintenance

Title: Pipes bang at the washer? Put an AA arrestor on hot and cold
Description: Pipes bang when a valve stops moving water too fast. Codes call for an ASSE 1010 arrestor at quick-closing valves and 80 psi max; aim for 45–60. Fixes inside.

Title: Where the mess lands tells you which fix you need
Description: A clean house re-messes because new stuff arrives daily with nowhere to go. Find your gap by where it lands, then cut the inflow and trade the big clean for short resets.
